environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type, no additional managed rules). SIGNING_KEY_SOURCE=env, SIGNING_KEY=dGVzdC1rZXktMTIzNDU2Nzg5MA== (base64 of 'test-key-1234567890'). No CDN or upstream cache layer. Function URL is publicly accessible. X-Forwarded-Host and X-Cache-Key headers are passed through unmodified by API Gateway HTTP API.
